I develop open-source software that makes antitrust and trade-policy simulation models available to researchers, practitioners, and students. These packages implement tools for merger simulation, market definition, tariff and quota analysis, and graphical interfaces for applied competition policy.

## R Packages

<div class="software-grid">
<div class="software-card">
<h3>antitrust</h3>
<p class="software-subtitle">Tools for Antitrust Practitioners</p>
<p>Implements merger simulation and calibration tools for differentiated-products demand, auctions, bargaining, vertical settings, upward pricing pressure, and related antitrust models.</p>
<pre><code>install.packages("antitrust")</code></pre>
<div class="paper-links">
<a href="https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=antitrust" target="_blank"><i class="fas fa-external-link-alt"></i> CRAN</a>
<a href="https://github.com/luciu5/antitrust" target="_blank"><i class="fab fa-github"></i> GitHub</a>
</div>
</div>

<div class="software-card">
<h3>trade</h3>
<p class="software-subtitle">Tools for Trade Policy Analysis</p>
<p>Provides tools for simulating tariff, quota, and trade-policy effects using applied economic models that support transparent policy analysis.</p>
<pre><code>install.packages("trade")</code></pre>
<div class="paper-links">
<a href="https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=trade" target="_blank"><i class="fas fa-external-link-alt"></i> CRAN</a>
<a href="https://github.com/luciu5/trade" target="_blank"><i class="fab fa-github"></i> GitHub</a>
</div>
</div>

<div class="software-card">
<h3>competitiontoolbox</h3>
<p class="software-subtitle">Graphical Tools for Competition Policy</p>
<p>Offers a graphical interface for selected antitrust and competition-policy tools, lowering the barrier to exploring simulation models and diagnostics.</p>
<pre><code>install.packages("competitiontoolbox")</code></pre>
